content:
Case ID: 1148
Case Type: Refund
Date: 2025-04-02
Handled By: Customer Support - Talia Brooks
Customer or Requestor: Kevin Rowe
Title: Partial refund for late delivery after guaranteed date

Issue Description
Customer requested compensation because an order promised for a birthday delivery date arrived two days late despite expedited shipping.

Steps Taken
- Confirmed the promised delivery date shown at checkout and the actual carrier delivery scan.
- Reviewed weather and network alerts to determine whether the delay qualified for an exception or goodwill handling.
- Verified the item was received in good condition and the customer did not request a full return.
- Applied the support policy for shipping-service recovery when late delivery materially affected the intended use date.

Resolution
Refunded the expedited shipping fee and applied a modest goodwill credit rather than a full merchandise refund because the order was ultimately delivered and retained.

Follow-Up
Support added the case to a weekly review of shipping promise misses on premium services.

Reference Documents
- Refund Playbook v2
- Internal Wiki - Refund Questions
